name: Saitou Chihiro
source:
"Please... molest me..."

A timid and reserved female student.

She was once nearly assaulted by some guys in her class. The incident left her traumatized, making her extremely timid about sexual acts, though at the same time, she was also awakened to an enjoyment of being touched. She even has a tendency to let herself be molested intentionally.

She is still bullied by her classmates, and the only person she can confide in is her beloved dog, Beth.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/chikandensya/chikan_top.htm]Official Site[/url]]
